messages.text: Hey! I wanted to update you - I tried the breathing exercises before my presentation yesterday and they really helped!
That's wonderful to hear! I'm so proud of you for putting those techniques into practice. How did the presentation go overall?
It went much better than expected! I still felt nervous but I was able to get through it without panicking. My classmates even asked good questions.

That's fantastic progress! You're building confidence and developing coping skills. The fact that your classmates engaged with questions shows your presentation was engaging. How are you feeling about future presentations now?
I feel more optimistic about them. I think I'm starting to realize that most people aren't really judging me as harshly as I thought.

I'm glad to hear you're feeling better! Keep practicing those techniques we discussed. You're developing great self-awareness and coping skills. Remember, progress isn't always linear, but you're definitely moving in the right direction!
